lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Howdie.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Are you my new Commander?
I am, nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Pleasure's all mine!

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: I heard you just graduated

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: from the military academy not too long ago.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: You're apparently very proficient.
I'm flattered.
Just doing my duty.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: You don't have to

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: be so modest around me.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: This isn't my first rodeo, and I've worked with plenty of Commanders before.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Texting them is always such a bore,

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: but I'm mighty impressed by your background,

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: so I figured I'd shoot you a message

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: and introduce myself.
I appreciate that.
You're too kind.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: I have to ask,

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: do you know who I am?
A titan in the daily necessities industry.
The owner of Talentum Mall.
A marketing prodigy.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Turns out you actually

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: do know something about me!

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Well, unless you plan on going up to the surface in your birthday suit,

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: you'll have to deal with me at least once or twice.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: As you said, I'm a businesswoman,

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: and I deal primarily in basic commodities.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: If you ask me though, the most important thing

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: to invest in... is people.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: So, I wonder,

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: do you like tea?
I do, but I rarely have an opportunity to drink it.
If you're talking about Splendamin tea, then no.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Not exactly surprising.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: After all, tea is a kind of plant,

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: and plants are a precious commodity around these parts.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Nevertheless, I'm sure there's enough tea

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: for us back at my office.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Splendamin tea?

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: How can you even compare that with actual tea?

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Do you know what it's actually made with?

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Forget about it. Just come to my office.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: I'll prepare you some real tea.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Tea made with real tea leaves is hard to come by,

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: but there should be enough for the two of us.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: We can sip some tea

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: and have a little discussion to see

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: how we can benefit from our acquaintance.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: What do you think?
Sounds good to me.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: All right,

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: I have a lot of work to catch up on.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: We'll have to find some other time to chat.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: I'll be in touch.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: I'm sure we'll see each other soon.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: We're bound to see each other at work.
Looking forward to it.
